text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Sonnet, the officer, was shown Haiku as a killer on night one and named them on day one, but Haiku turned the table with pointed questions about Sonnet's toast. Sol, the mayor, was killed on night two, and Haiku skipped past his death, which Luna seized on as proof of guilt. Haiku then pressed Luna so hard that Terra joined the vote against her, and the town sent Luna out as a citizen. Haiku and Terra, the two killers, survived to the end, while Sonnet, Sol, and Luna were lost along the way, and Gemma, the doctor, never got the chance to save anyone who mattered.
